description: Golden certification corpus with expected verdicts for production claims. Per CEO P0-D: the verifier cannot be both judge AND ground truth. Each claim has an independently determined expected verdict.

expected_verdicts.expected_reason: VIEshunt SECONDARY_REPORTED — blocked because source verification states (content_verified, support_verified) are not yet set to true by the system
expected_verdicts.notes: The source has valid content and hashes, but the three-state verification (identity/content/support) requires all three to be explicitly verified. certification_rule: The gate compares actual_verdict vs expected_verdict for each claim. ALL must match for G7 to PASS. The verifier is NOT self-approving — the golden corpus is the independent ground truth.
